layouts.name: San Luis Potosi
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The full Tangamanga II course retains both western and northern returns, the long main straight and the eastern roundabout. The federation describes a 2350 m circuit and a grid extending to the roundabout. The roundabout is independently mapped as an unclassified road, so raceway-only country extraction omitted the connected eastern return. Exact current raceway and roundabout nodes give 2345.0 m against the supplied 2337 m. The northern shortcut, western bypass, pit-side detour, roundabout service spokes and separate karting course are excluded. Travel direction and historical event furniture remain provisional; no coordinates or joins are invented to match the diagram or distance. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 2345.0 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
